name: clickhouse-sql
description: Syntax highlighting and syntax checking for ClickHouse SQL
author: Valery Petrov <valerypetrov@icloud.com>

enumDescriptions: Keywords keep the case they are written in
clickhouseSql.format.keywordCase.markdownDescription:
The case of keywords when **Format Document** and **Format Selection** lay out ClickHouse SQL. Only words that the parser reads as keywords change; names, strings and comments stay as written.

For example, `"lower"` formats `SELECT a FROM t` as `select a from t`. It can differ per language, as in `"[clickhouse-sql]": { "clickhouseSql.format.keywordCase": "lower" }`.

clickhouseSql.maxFileSize.markdownDescription:
Files longer than this many characters get no syntax check, semantic highlighting, formatting, outline, folding, Expand Selection, completion, hover, signature help, go to definition, references, rename or server check, which would slow VS Code down; a message says so once per file. The TextMate highlighting still works.

For example, `20000000` lets files of up to 20 million characters in.

clickhouseSql.server.enabled.markdownDescription:
Check names, functions and types against a ClickHouse server, and complete its databases, tables and columns. Each SELECT, and the SELECT of `CREATE ... AS SELECT` and `INSERT ... SELECT`, is sent as `EXPLAIN QUERY TREE` with `readonly=1`, so nothing is changed; the server still runs its scalar subqueries, within limits of 2 s, rows, bytes and memory. The names come from `system.databases`, `system.tables` and `system.columns`.

The values that `SET param_x = ...` gives earlier in the file are sent with the queries that use `{x:Type}`. Only your user settings count, never a workspace's, so that a folder you open cannot send your SQL to another server.

clickhouseSql.server.url.patternErrorMessage: An http:// or https:// URL of the HTTP interface, such as http://localhost:8123.
clickhouseSql.server.url.markdownDescription:
The [HTTP interface](https://clickhouse.com/docs/interfaces/http) of the ClickHouse server: `http://` or `https://`, the host and the HTTP port, which is 8123 by default and 8443 with TLS. For example `http://localhost:8123` or `https://abc123.eu-west-1.aws.clickhouse.cloud:8443`.

The native port 9000, which `clickhouse-client` uses, does not answer HTTP. Only your user settings count, never a workspace's, so that a folder you open cannot send your SQL to another server.

clickhouseSql.server.user.markdownDescription: The ClickHouse user, such as `default` or `readonly_user`. Set its password with the **ClickHouse SQL: Set Server Password** command; it is kept in VS Code's secret storage for this user at this URL. Only your user settings count, never a workspace's, so that a folder you open cannot send your SQL to another server.

clickhouseSql.server.database.markdownDescription: The database of table names written without one, as `USE` sets it in `clickhouse-client`, such as `logs`; empty for the default database of the user. A database the server does not have is shown as a connection problem. Only your user settings count, never a workspace's, so that a folder you open cannot send your SQL to another server.

clickhouseSql.server.timeoutMs.markdownDescription: How long to wait for each answer of the server, in milliseconds, such as `5000` for 5 seconds. Queries also stop on the server after 2 seconds, or after this time when it is shorter. Only your user settings count, never a workspace's, so that a folder you open cannot send your SQL to another server.
